meta.note: All field elements are decimal strings. pathIndex is LeanIMT's compressed proof.index (one bit per level that had a sibling, level 0 = LSB), not the leaf index; depth = number of real siblings; siblings are padded with 0 to 20. Proofs are snarkjs JSON and re-randomised on every run; everything else is deterministic.
